notes.en:
**Summary and General Analysis**

✦ March 7th is a shield based sustain unit capable of unleashing Counter attacks.

✦ March 7th's Skill grants a shield to a single ally and increases that ally's chance of being targeted by enemies. When a shielded ally is attacked, March 7th launches a Counter Attack, up to two counters per turn.

✦ March 7th's ultimate deals AoE damage with a low chance to Freeze enemies.

✦ March 7th is a weak sustain unit, often unable to keep the team alive in most content.

**Additional Notes**

✦ Use any appropriate supportive Planar set.

✦ EHR needed to guarantee Freeze against 20% / 40% RES enemies.
